newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber ends year-end session firmer.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber ends year-end session firmer.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended this year's last trading session higher across the board on Friday, lifted by short-covering for position adjustment, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.3 yen to 1.1 yen per kg firmer, with benchmark June ending up 1.1 yen at 149.9 yen.

The market continued to be supported by the yen's weaker tendency against the dollar and recent falls in Japan's rubber stocks. "Market sentiment has improved after the benchmark June reached 150 yen in the first session," one trader said.
Trading will resume on January 6 next year.
